protocol: sealed truth-free SwiGLU gate identification v1
teachers: 3 fresh project-owned HF Llama teachers (hidden 32, vocab 16, 2 layers, 4Q/2KV, SwiGLU 64, norm gains 1+0.3N), initializer_range 0.2, seeds from secrets.randbits, stored only in private storage
observations_given_to_solver: block-0 MLP normalized input z = rmsnorm_unit(x + a) and output m on 512x8 public random token sequences (seed 91); nothing else
solver: modelforge.swiglu_identification.identify(width=64, over_width=192, seeds=(11,23,37), seconds=600), separate process, no teacher access
verifier: separate process after solver output is hashed; loads teacher, compares norm-absorbed gate rows
primary_metric: number of true gate rows (of 64) matched within 5% relative distance
